meta.title: The Sandcastle and the Wave
meta.textType: story: guessing what happens next from pictures

paragraphs: On Sunday, the family goes to the beach. They arrive at ten o'clock. The ocean is big and blue, and the sand is warm. The sun is hot, but the water is cool. Tom finds a good spot near the water. Mom sits under an umbrella with Pip. "We are going to build a castle," says Tom. "It is going to be amazing!" says Lily. She is very excited.

Tom and Lily work together on the castle. Tom makes a gate, and Lily makes two towers. Lily puts small stones on the gate. They both work hard, and the castle gets big. Dad stands next to them with a blue bucket. "It is going to be the best castle on the beach," he says. Look at the picture. A big wave is coming! What is going to happen? Tom and Lily point at the wave and open their mouths.

The wave comes, and the castle is gone. Tom and Lily are surprised. Pip runs away from the water and hides behind Mom. Then they look at each other and laugh. "The ocean is strong!" says Lily. They decide to build a new castle far from the water. Pip digs a hole next to the new castle. "I will wait here and watch," says Mom.

Tom and Lily work all morning. They finish the new castle before lunch. "This castle is taller than the first one!" says Tom. "Is the ocean going to come here?" asks Dad. "No, the wave is not going to come," says Tom. "Tomorrow, I am going to draw this castle," says Lily. Mom smiles and says, "Now it is time for lunch."
text.summary: Tom and Lily build a big sandcastle at the beach. A big wave comes, and the castle is gone, so they build a new one.
